newsitem.title: USA: Scotts to build $9.1 mln warehouse at hq.
newsitem.headline: Scotts to build $9.1 mln warehouse at hq.

text.p: The Scotts Company said Wednesday it will start construction this month on a $9.1 million warehouse facility at its headquarters complex here.
The company said the 450,000-square-foot building, adjacent to an existing 250,000-square-foot warehouse, will generate $1 million in new tax revenues for Union County over the next five years.

The facility will hold an average monthly inventory of $15 million in Scotts products, the lawn and garden products company said. It will allow the company to consolidate its central Ohio inventories in one location.
The new facility will have a storage capacity in excess of 60 million pounds of finished product, loading dock doors for 45 trucks, and parking for more than 200 trailers, Scotts said.
The Union County Commissioners granted Scotts a 50 percent tax abatement on real and personal property taxes associated with the new warehouse for five years, Scotts said.
